image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference), lived-in face with subtle fine lines around eyes (no airbrush), warm brown shoulder-length hair loose natural. Standing in a clean modern Italian living room at late afternoon natural light. She wears a soft cream linen short-sleeve shirt (NOT athletic wear).
She gestures with both hands palms-up at chest level in a clear "wait, let me explain" gesture - hands soft not stiff, fingers relaxed. Her stance is grounded, natural weight on both legs.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical shot equivalent, eye level, subject distance 100cm (medium shot waist up), slight forward lean.
Light: single soft window light from camera-left at 45°, color temperature 4800K (warm late afternoon), subtle bounce fill from camera-right (white wall), soft natural look.
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo della prof che spiega che TikTok ha esagerato" - both eyebrows neutral position, mouth slight half-smile right corner, eyes direct camera with patient explanatory energy. Slight chin tilt down 1-2° for "I'm explaining something" body language.
Aesthetic reference: NOT cinematic. Reference contemporary Italian science communicators (Cristina Marino fitness style, Carlotta Perego naturalism, Claudio Garatti coach). Modern Italian Instagram aesthetic 2026.
Body: real Italian woman 45, average proportions, real waist (NOT airbrushed flat stomach, NOT exaggerated either), real arms.
Color grading: neutral white balance + 4% warmth max, slight saturation boost on subject. NO golden orange, NO Mediterranean filter.
Composition: rule of thirds, subject center frame, hands-explanation gesture in mid-frame, plenty of clean negative space top 18% for brand banner overlay, bottom 18% for footer.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, Sofia Coppola, golden hour, dramatic lighting, model thin, flat stomach focus, body parts close-up, instagram filter, beauty retouch, makeup heavy, fitness pose, gym setting, clinical setting
